title: Provision release tokens for every package registry
context: Create scoped release credentials for every package registry, store them outside

spec.summary: Provision release tokens for every package registry
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Tokens are scoped to publish only.
No token appears in logs, PRs, or the repository.
A dry run succeeds where supported.
A non-release job has no token.
